Standard (MIT) plugins only: daygrid, timegrid, list, multimonth, interaction. No premium/scheduler plugin, no licence key.
Why not v7: 7.1.5 (npm latest, released 2026-11-12) ships only an unminified 957 KB global bundle and needs a separate Temporal polyfill; 6.1.22 (legacy tag, 2026-10-16) is the maintained self-contained Standard Bundle.
